title: 【Marvelous Designer 10】 Learning Day Special Guest UV-Zhu & New Feature Demonstration p02 UV-Zhu
description: In this study day, Sherry will present a demonstration of the new features in Marvelous Designer 10, and Teacher Zhu will demonstrate how to integrate Marvelous Designer with other 3D software. For more information, you can visit the manual on our official website: https://marvelousdesigner.zendesk.com/hc/zh-cn/categories/360002390871-Manual. We welcome everyone to join our QQ group (after following the account or sending a private message, you will automatically receive the group number and password!).
